 By Bebo Rani Last Updated: Nov 12, 2026, 15:02 IST SSC GD Physical Admit Card 2026: SSC has released the SSC GD Constable PET/PST Admit Card on November 12, 2026, on its official website,ssc.gov.in. Candidates who qualified for the written exam can now download their physical call letter PDF from the direct link given below.
 SSC GD Physical Admit Card 2026 OUT: Download Constable PET/PST Call Letter at ssc.gov.in Key Points
 The SSC GD PET/PST Admit Card 2026 was released on 12 November 2026.
 Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST) are from 26 Nov to 11 Dec 2026.
 Qualified candidates can download their admit card from the official website ssc.gov.in.
 SSC GD PET/PST Admit Card 2026 OUT: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the SSC GD PET PST Admit Card 2026 on 12 November 2026. Candidates who qualified in the written exam can now download their physical test call letter from the official website, ssc.gov.in. This recruitment is for Constable (GD) posts in the Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs) and SSF, and Rifleman (GD) posts in Assam Rifles. The written exam result was declared on 12 October 2026. The admit card is a must-carry document for the physical test. In this article, we share the direct download steps, important instructions, and other key details. 
 SSC GD Physical Admit Card 2026 Download PDF 
 The SSC GD PET PST Admit Card 2026 PDF is now available online for candidates who qualified in the written exam. You can download it from the official website, ssc.gov.in, or from your regional SSC website. Keep your login details ready before you start. Check the direct link below:

 Steps to Download SSC GD Admit Card 2026 
 Candidates who qualified in the written exam can download the physical test call letter online. Follow the steps below to get your admit card without any trouble. 
 Visit the official website, ssc.gov.in, or the regional SSC website for your region. 
 Log in with your registration number or roll number and password. If you have forgotten your password, use the "Forgot Password" option to reset it. 
 Go to the "Admit Card" or "Latest News" section on the homepage. 
 Click on the link for SSC GD Constable PET/PST Admit Card 2026. 
 Select your region and enter your registration number or roll number, along with your date of birth or password, as asked. 
 Click on the submit button. Your admit card will appear on the screen. 
 Check all the details, such as name, roll number, test date, time and venue. 
 Download the admit card as a PDF and take a clear printout for the physical test.
